- reflectsIsosField_holds: descent along the faithfully flat K -> Omega.
S1794.fiberFunctorOfFields assembles the class from field 1 + the five residuals (has sorryAx; audited in the file).

REUSE HINT for whoever continues (probed and confirmed, not yet finished):
Fite: F & FintypeCat.incl = (finiteEtale K).iota.op & Phi is rfl at object and morphism level, where Phi S = (S.unop ->_alg[K] Omega), and yoneda_preservesLimits is an instance. I did not fabricate anything: the five residuals are explicitly sorry with exact statements and the file's own axiom audit prints which declarations depend on sorryAx.`;
await tools.send_message({ agent_id: "session-f6ded1d8-b5c8-45b3-93ce-a5ae39a93db1", message: msg });
